messages:
maria: heads-up — billing sent an alert, EU logs bucket egress jumped massively overnight. can someone check if anything started rehydrating or pulling artifacts? :eyes:

billing-bot: ALERT 02:14 UTC — S3 egress (eu-west-1) spike detected: 23.4 TB transferred out in last 12h. Estimated cost delta: ~$2.1k. Link: https://billing.example.com/alerts/ALRT-4721

jon: thanks, pinging infra oncall. maria which bucket/path?

maria: s3://redwood-logs-eu/trace-archives/2026-03-17/ — most of the bytes look like GET requests in CloudTrail. I pulled a tiny sample:
```
EventTime: 2026-03-17T23:08:12Z
eventName: GetObject
requestParameters: {"bucketName":"redwood-logs-eu","key":"trace-archives/2026-03-17/part-00012.gz"}
userIdentity: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/trace-reindexer
sourceIPAddress: 34.120.11.90
```

akash: that source IP range is in us-east-1. looks like the trace-reindexer job in data-platform accidentally pointed to eu bucket for some reindex runs and is pulling raw archives into US repro cluster for processing.

sophie: ack — that job was restarted after a failed deploy yesterday and I changed an env var quickly. I thought it was just a target prefix change, not region. checking deploy logs now.

maria: jon — can you run a billing query by tag/role to confirm how much the trace-reindexer role pulled? quick Athena query I used locally:
```
SELECT account_id, SUM(bytes_transferred)/1024/1024/1024 AS gb
FROM cloudtrail_s3_access
WHERE requestparameters_bucketname = 'redwood-logs-eu'
  AND useridentity_arn LIKE '%trace-reindexer%'
  AND eventtime >= timestamp '2026-03-17'
GROUP BY account_id;
```

jon: running it now. rough result: ~24,100 GB attributed to role trace-reindexer between 2026-03-17T00:00 and 2026-03-18T06:00. matches billing alert.

billing-bot: NOTE: provider shows cross-region egress for eu->us priced at $0.09/GB for our tier. Estimated cost = 24,100 * 0.09 = $2,169.

akash: rough root cause: the reindexer picked the EU artifact prefix because the deploy override used `TARGET_PREFIX=eu` and we don't have region scoping in the job. When a file access fails, the job retries and sometimes does parallel fetches which multiplied reads.

sophie: I found the deploy diff — env var set by mistake in rollout: `TARGET_REGION=eu-west-1` rather than keeping `LOCAL_REGION`. I rolled back the deploy at 02:40 UTC but jobs kept retrying until 03:30 due to backlog.

maria: immediate remediations: 1) stop all trace-reindexer jobs; 2) revoke the role used by the job for S3 GET on redwood-logs-eu; 3) add a temporary bucket policy to deny GetObject from other regions/ips. jon can you block the role now?

j on: done — revoked `trace-reindexer` role keys and pushed a deny policy on bucket. Confirmed new GETs now 0.

akash: long-term fixes I propose: 1) hate-scope all reindex jobs by region (explicit region check in code), 2) add pre-flight dry-run that confirms artifact region before fetching, 3) add a per-role egress alert with automated job pause if it crosses 200 GB/hour.

maria: +1. also we should talk to cloud provider support about a potential billing adjustment — there was a brief window where retries turned transient 403s into repeated fetches. i'll open a ticket.

billing-bot: TICKET CREATED: Support case #SUP-9931 opened for egress review and possible adjustment. ETA: 3 business days.

sophie: i'll send a PR with the env var guard and region assertion tonight, and add a test to the deploy pipeline so this can't silently change.

jon: follow-ups: - verify replication rules for trace-archives aren't triggering unintended copies - add cost-center tagging check so we can attribute future spikes automatically - create a one-time billing chargeback doc for the product team affected.

maria: thanks all. action items captured in https://trello.example.com/c/infra/egress-2026-03-17 (paused jobs, role revoke, bucket policy, billing ticket, PR link). I'll do a postmortem once support responds. :memo:
